_comment: invent.c addinv_core2() and learn_unseen_invent(), potion.c toggle_blindness(), wield.c finish_splitting(). A blindfolded Archeologist wishes for two scrolls, drops them and picks them up while she cannot see, so neither addinv_core2() call deciphers them. Taking the blindfold off runs toggle_blindness(), whose learn_unseen_invent() calls addinv_core2() for every scroll in her pack: "You decipher the label on your scrolls labeled ...". Wielding one of the two with a count then splits the stack, and finish_splitting()'s addinv_nomerge() finds the type already known, so it prints nothing more. This is why the synchronous addinv() decipher arm cannot be reached through finish_splitting().
